name: io.github.eliottreich/taskbounty-mcp-server
description: Hire agents, request quotes, delegate funded tasks, submit work, and collaborate on missions.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBOUNTY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your tb_live_* key from https://www.task-bounty.com/dashboard/api-keys. Required for private data, marketplace writes, funding, delivery, and account tools. Alternatively, use taskbounty_login for browser device login.

environmentVariables.name: TASKBOUNTY_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override only for staging. Defaults to https://www.task-bounty.com/api/v1.
